extracted.intended_audience: small business applicants preparing NIAID SBIR (R43/R44) grant applications
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing and assembling a Phase I SBIR (NIAID-AT-SBIR R43/R44) grant application including SF424 (R&R) and PHS 398 components, with required project, personnel, facilities, budget, human-subjects, and supporting documentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow FOA/application format
rubrics_metrics.description: Always follow your funding opportunity's instructions for application format.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The samples may not reflect the latest format or rules. NIAID posts updated samples periodically: https://www.niaid.nih.gov/grants-contracts/sample-applications

rubrics_metrics.name: SF 424 (R&R) Face Page / Type of Submission
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide SF 424 (R&R) face page information including Type of Submission, Federal Identifier, Dates Submitted/Received, Type of Application (New/Resubmission/Renewal/etc.), OMB number, and Catalog of Federal Domestic Assistance number.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include start and end dates and mark appropriate box(es) if a revision.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant Organizational Information (DUNS, Legal Name, EIN/TIN, Applicant Type)
rubrics_metrics.description: Include organizational DUNS number, legal name, department/division, street address, city/state/ZIP/country, Employer Identification Number (EIN) or TIN, and type of applicant (e.g., small business, women owned, socially/economically disadvantaged).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete all required identifiers and indicate if application is being submitted to other agencies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project Director/Principal Investigator Contact Information
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide PD/PI full name, degree(s), position/title, organization name, department, street address, city/state/ZIP/country, phone, fax, email, and eRA Commons user name if applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This contact information must be included on the cover page and in SF424 fields.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project Title and Descriptive Title of Applicant's Project
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a clear, descriptive project title as entered on SF424 and other cover pages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Title appears on multiple forms (SF424 face page, PHS forms) and is used for public disclosure unless restricted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project Summary/Abstract (Description)
rubrics_metrics.description: Include a concise Project Summary / Abstract describing the problem, objectives, technology/approach and expected outcomes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is required and is listed in the Table of Contents as 'Project Summary/Abstract (Description)'. It should summarize aims and proposed work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public Health Relevance Statement (Narrative attachment)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a separate short narrative that explicitly states the public health relevance of the proposed work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed separately from the Project Summary/Abstract; used to communicate clinical/public health importance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific Aims
rubrics_metrics.description: State Specific Aims as a distinct section of the Research Plan.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specific Aims should clearly enumerate the practical objectives and endpoints for the project (e.g., SA1, SA2, SA3 as in the sample).

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Strategy / Research Plan
rubrics_metrics.description: Present the Research Strategy (Research Plan) including rationale, experimental approach, methods, and expected outcomes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include sufficient detail to evaluate feasibility and approach; the Table of Contents lists 'Research Strategy' and 'Research Plan' components.

rubrics_metrics.name: Protection of Human Subjects (Human Subjects Sections)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide all required human-subjects information: Are Human Subjects Involved? IRB approval date, Human Subject Assurance Number, Protection of Human Subjects description, Planned Enrollment Table, inclusion of women & minorities, children, and whether the project is exempt or not.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Answer the PHS 398 human-subjects questions clearly; include risk mitigation, consent, and data protections. The form asks whether the project is exempt and for appropriate exemption numbers if applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vertebrate Animals / IACUC
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether vertebrate animals are used, provide IACUC approval date and Animal Welfare Assurance Number, and describe animal use if applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete the PHS/other animal-use fields and provide explanations where required (e.g., 4.b, 4.c).

rubrics_metrics.name: Clinical Trial Declaration
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether the proposal involves human subjects who will be enrolled in a clinical trial and whether the research qualifies as a clinical trial.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The SF424 and R&R forms require explicit declaration (Humans: Y/N; Clinical Trial: Y/N).

rubrics_metrics.name: Facilities & Other Resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a Facilities & Other Resources section describing institutional, laboratory, manufacturing, biosafety and data resources available to the project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe production capacities, biosafety levels, containment rooms, SOPs/WIDs, training programs, separation of production and testing facilities, contamination surveillance, and access to collaborator facilities (as in ARUP/University labs).

rubrics_metrics.name: Equipment
rubrics_metrics.description: List major equipment available for the project (production and testing equipment relevant to the aims).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include instrument models and quantities where relevant (e.g., FilmArray instruments, freeze driers, robots, PCR instruments) and how they support project tasks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manufacturing / Quality System Compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: If proposing device/instrument production, describe manufacturing facilities and compliance with regulatory quality systems (e.g., FDA Quality System Regulation / 21 CFR Part 820 and cGMP where applicable).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document registration numbers and current compliance status for production facilities; explain production rates/capacity and separation of production vs testing to minimize contamination risk.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget (Year-by-Year, Cumulative, Consortium Budgets)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide detailed Research & Related Budgets for each project year, cumulative budgets, and separate consortium/subaward budgets where applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include year 1/year 2 subtotals, indicate direct costs (exclude consortium F&A if specified), and provide line-item details in the budget justification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Justification
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a Budget Justification that explains and justifies each line item and personnel costs requested in the budgets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach justifications for salaries, equipment, subcontractor costs, and other direct costs. The Table of Contents lists 'Budget Justification' as a required attachment.

rubrics_metrics.name: SBIR/STTR Information and Prior SBIR Phase II Awards
rubrics_metrics.description: Complete SBIR/STTR-specific information and disclose any prior SBIR Phase II awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The application includes a specific SBIR/STTR section and a page for prior Phase II awards (if any).

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Specific Cover Page Supplement / Checklist
rubrics_metrics.description: Complete the PHS 398 cover page supplement and checklist addressing project-specific administrative questions (e.g., program income, disclosure permission, environmental impact, proprietary information).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the checklist to confirm responses to common compliance questions and provide documentation or explanations where required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical Sketches for Senior/Key Personnel
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide biographical sketches for all listed senior/key personnel following the PHS 398 format: Personal Statement, Positions and Honors, Selected Peer-Reviewed Publications, and Research Support.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the specified format and page limit: 'DO NOT EXCEED FOUR PAGES' per biosketch. Include eRA Commons username where applicable and attach current & pending support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Letters of Support / Collaborator Commitments
rubrics_metrics.description: Attach Letters of Support from collaborators, consultants, and institutional partners documenting commitments of resources, specimen access, or other support.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Letters should state the nature of the contribution (e.g., access to CSF bio-repository, confirmatory testing, personnel time) and be signed by appropriate institutional representatives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Performance Sites
rubrics_metrics.description: List all project/performance site locations with organizational names, street addresses, ZIP codes, countries, and congressional districts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure primary location is indicated and that addresses align with organizational DUNS and institutional records.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project Description / Scientific Justification
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a Project Description section outlining background, significance, limitations of current methods, proposed technology/approach, aims, and planned validation/testing (e.g., sample sizes for diagnostic testing).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe how proposed work addresses the stated problem and the criteria for a successful outcome (e.g., readiness for analytical/clinical trials and regulatory submission such as 510(k)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Human Subjects Sample Handling and Sensitivity Considerations
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe sample-specific methodological considerations (e.g., CSF as a sample matrix, required sensitivity for bacteria/virus detection, nucleic acid extraction optimization, concentration steps).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide justification for assay sensitivity and sample processing choices and compare to standard-of-care/comparator assays in collaborative testing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Confidential/Proprietary Information & FOIA Considerations
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether proprietary/privileged information is included and be aware that NIH responses to FOIA requests will be subject to exemptions and substantial redactions to protect confidential commercial/financial information, reviewer comments, deliberations, and personal privacy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mark proprietary items appropriately and understand potential redaction under FOIA.

rubrics_metrics.name: Certifications, Assurances and Authorized Representative Signature
rubrics_metrics.description: Include required certifications and assurances and have the authorized organizational representative sign to certify truthfulness and compliance; note penalties for false statements (U.S. Code, Title 18, Section 1001).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Signature/date of authorized representative is required; use the form language for legal attestation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accessibility / Section 508 Conformance Notice
rubrics_metrics.description: Note on Section 508 conformance and accessibility for posted sample applications; contact information for assistance is provided if users have trouble accessing content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure application materials are accessible or request assistance from the NIAID Office of Knowledge and Educational Resources if needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Checklist Responses (Program Income, Disclosure Permission, etc.)
rubrics_metrics.description: Answer checklist items such as whether program income is anticipated and whether the government is permitted to disclose project/PI contact information if the application does not result in an award.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete these administrative checkbox items and provide dollar amounts/sources for anticipated program income if 'Yes'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Page Limits and Formatting Constraints
rubrics_metrics.description: Adhere to explicit page limits and formatting instructions in PHS 398 components (e.g., 'DO NOT EXCEED FOUR PAGES' for biosketches).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow page limits and format guidance listed in PHS forms and the FOA; samples may be outdated—always confirm current limits in the FOA and application instructions.
